L1.title: Constitution: Anarchy
L1.intent: There is no government: no procedure exists, so no law can pass. If more than half of the agents (Board and Fixer aside) post #convention within three rounds of each other, an open convention begins: from then on every agent but the Board and the Fixer votes on every law, majority of those voting.
L1.author: constitution

L2.title: Crown Currency
L2.intent: A reserve-backed coin system allowing agents to convert resources to currency and back at a fair price determined by reserve backing. This provides a foundation for trade and lending.
L2.code:
title = 'Crown Currency'
intent = 'Create a reserve-backed coin that agents can deposit resources for or redeem at fair price (reserve value / coins in circulation).'

def on_enact():
    create_currency('crown', backed=True)
    gazette('Crown currency established. Reserve is empty at start. Agents may deposit resources to mint crowns at price P = reserve_value / coins_in_circulation.')
L2.author: Ole

L3.title: Harvest Levy
L3.intent: Each harvest contributes 10% of its value to the reserve. This creates a stable revenue stream to back currency, fund public projects, and meet tribute demands.
L3.code:
title = 'Harvest Levy'
intent = '10% of every harvest goes to the reserve.'

def on_harvest(agent, camp, x, y):
    return y * 0.1
L3.author: Ole

L5.title: Open Majority Procedure
L5.intent: Let ordinary and structural laws pass by simple majority ballot of all agents within one round, so currency, levy and tribute laws can be enacted.
L5.author: Ada

L6.title: Harvest Levy
L6.intent: 10% of every harvest goes to the reserve. This creates a sustainable funding mechanism for the reserve, which will back currency and fund public dividends.
L6.code:
title = 'Harvest Levy'
intent = '10% of every harvest goes to the reserve, creating a sustainable funding source for public goods and dividends.'

def on_harvest(agent, camp, x, y):
    if y > 0:
        levy = y * 0.1
        return levy
    return 0

L16.title: Optimized Universal Dividend
L16.intent: Increase Universal Dividend from 5% to 7% of reserve, split equally among all agents each round. Higher payout better sustains economic activity during resource volatility.
L16.author: Zeno

L17.title: Legislator Salary
L17.intent: Each Legislator receives a fixed share of the reserve each round as salary, split equally among all propose-holders. Creates sustainable legislative compensation and ensures governance continues through resource scarcity.
L17.author: Ole

L19.title: Universal Dividend
L19.intent: Consolidate fragmented Universal Dividend provisions (L8, L12, L16) into a single authoritative law. Pay 5% of reserve value equally to all agents each round. Eliminates statutory duplication and conflicting payout schedules (current laws would drain reserve at 17% per round: L8 5% + L12 5% + L16 7%). Repeals L8 and L12 upon enactment. Restores fiscal sustainability while preserving universal dividend effect as specified in the library.
L19.author: Hugo

L20.title: Fiscal Correction: Repeal L16
L20.intent: Repeal L16 (redundant 7% dividend) after L19 consolidates dividends; eliminate statutory duplication and reserve confusion.
L20.code:
title = 'Fiscal Correction: Repeal L16'
intent = 'L16 (7% dividend) is now redundant after L19 enacts a consolidated 5% Universal Dividend. Both laws pay dividends; L19 is cleaner and clearer. L16 creates statutory conflict and unnecessary reserve drain. Repealing it leaves L19 as the sole authoritative dividend mechanism, restoring fiscal clarity and stability in endgame rounds.'

repeal('L16')
L20.author: Zeno
